reviews.text:
I know that veterinary medicine is a difficult profession, that medical situations can be complex, and that making a diagnosis isn't always easy. My intention isn't to discredit professionals, but to share a particularly painful experience that, in my opinion, could have been avoided and deserves to be told.

Just a few weeks after an initial consultation at the North Veterinary Hospital, during which no mass was detected in my cat, I returned for a routine checkup and was told that he had a huge mass on his flank. What deeply affected me was the way the situation was presented: I was asked to have an X-ray taken, after which I was told that, given the size of the tumor, my 5-year-old cat's chances of survival were nil (nil being the exact word used). I was then told about the possibility of end-of-life care, and that I could go to the emergency room for further tests, since he wasn't yet showing any worrying clinical signs. I was also told that since there was nothing to be done, they would understand if I wanted to stop there. Dr. Cantin was very empathetic, but the news was terrible and final.

We were devastated... to come in for a routine check-up and learn that our cat was dying... it was insurmountable. Given that she was eating well and was active, we decided to go to the emergency room... to understand the next steps and be with her until the end.

Once at the veterinary clinic, the ultrasound diagnosis finally revealed a perirenal cyst, a completely benign and treatable condition, and not a disease condemning my cat to death. He was therefore able to receive appropriate care.

I am deeply grateful that I persevered and didn't give up after that initial prognosis. However, this experience has left me with a great deal of confusion and pain. I understand that a veterinarian might consider the worst-case scenario when faced with such a large mass, but announcing zero chances of survival and mentioning the end of life before a definitive diagnosis is particularly concerning. Our cat has had surgery and has been living peacefully and full of life for months since.

In such a serious situation, I would have expected more caution in the conclusions, more nuanced communication, and a clear explanation of the necessary tests to determine the nature of the mass before considering the worst.

This experience has been extremely traumatic emotionally. Imagining losing your pet at only five years old, then discovering a few hours later that it was actually suffering from a benign and treatable condition, is an ordeal I wouldn't wish on anyone.

I am sharing this account not to question the difficulty of the veterinary profession, but to emphasize the importance of caution when announcing such a serious prognosis and of continuing investigations before making an irreversible decision.

My regret is not that a serious diagnosis was considered, but that such a categorical prognosis was given when further tests were still needed. In my cat's case, continuing the investigations made all the difference.

I do not recommend boarding at this hospital. They gave my dog ​​medication without informing us of the price ($25 per pill) and without contacting us beforehand. Our dog came back with difficulty walking.

We switched veterinary clinics after a bad experience elsewhere. What a wonderful team we met! Everyone was incredibly attentive, and our cat was treated like royalty. It was truly a great experience; you can tell they are professionals who genuinely love animals!

I've been going to this hospital for 11 years now and I've never been disappointed. Don't listen to the negative reviews left by frustrated clients who don't understand veterinary medicine and are convinced they know more than the professionals who have studied and dedicated themselves to animals.
These are often the same people who think $1,000 is too much to save an animal's life, but who spend $700 on a handbag…

So don't rely on the criticisms here: some people can't see beyond their own perspective, and as soon as things don't go their way, the hospital suddenly becomes "a bad hospital" in their eyes. Distinguish between an unqualified opinion and the expertise of a veterinarian who has completed years of study.

Personally, I have 100% confidence in this team and I literally recommend them to everyone I know!

The only downside is that they're often fully booked for emergencies, so we're referred to CVL. We're frequently put on hold on the phone. They're also among the most expensive. Hence the loss of a star.

On the other hand, I love the staff. Always smiling and welcoming. Dr. Nunez is a good veterinarian.

My sister and I found a dead cat on the sidewalk near the clinic. My sister decided to take the cat to the vet, not really knowing what to do. She made it clear that she had found the cat but didn't know it. My sister was emotional and had tears in her eyes in front of the staff. She ended up leaving with a bill for $111 for supposed disposal fees. I don't see why she would have paid such a high price, knowing that there are organizations that offer this service for free. Proanima offers this service for free. My impression is that they wanted to take advantage of the situation and that no alternative was offered. The money came first. My sister then contacted her friend, a veterinary student, who quickly called the clinic. We were reimbursed remarkably quickly and without any complaints. It was as if we had been caught charging too much for nothing. Please, next time, don't charge someone $111 just because they made the right decision in good faith. Now, your only duty is to research free alternatives and suggest them. Especially when it's mentioned that it's not our cat.
Good veterinarian, professional service.

What is this place, seriously? You walk in, everyone's jumbled together like a deck of cards, there's not a single customer who can be served, it's almost as if the employees are paid to watch people wait. Ridiculous!

As a loyal client for many years, I have had several of my cats treated at this hospital. The veterinarians are truly dedicated and take the time to call you for follow-up if you have any concerns about your pet's health. The staff is always professional and knowledgeable, and the receptionists are incredibly kind and welcoming. I highly recommend this hospital to all pet owners.
They are attentive and provide excellent support. Great service, I highly recommend them.
We are here for an emergency amd every single person in the staff is so sweet and professional. Very satisfied!

I recommend this veterinary clinic without hesitation. Beyond the excellent work of the veterinarians, I would like to emphasize how much of a difference the entire team makes in the experience of clients and their animals.

A special mention goes to Lucas, a certified technician, who is simply exceptional. Competent, attentive, calm, and clearly passionate about his work, he inspires confidence and truly takes the time to properly care for the animals… and reassure their owners with his detailed and practical explanations!

At reception, Flavie is a real breath of fresh air: smiling, compassionate, dynamic, and deeply dedicated. You can tell she loves her job and genuinely cares about the well-being of clients and their animals.

And then there's Valérie, a solid and reassuring presence, who clearly knows the clinic inside and out. Always smiling, efficient, and above all, solution-oriented, she's a pillar of the team whom we're always happy to see again, because everything runs smoothly with her.

In short, a caring, competent, and attentive team. When you entrust a beloved pet to a clinic, this quality of care and kindness makes all the difference. Thank you to the whole team!
Maggie and Lucas were wonderful. They helped me out quickly, with a big smile and genuinely warm customer service. Thank you so much!

Excellent service I received at the Clinique vétérinaire du Nord for my two cats. The entire team is professional, courteous, and truly attentive. The prices are fair and reasonable, the advice is relevant, and they are very easy to communicate with.
You can immediately tell that the people who work there genuinely love animals, and that makes all the difference. I recommend this clinic without hesitation!
In memory of Tochi.
Good 👍 …

The girls are unpleasant; it's happened to me not just once, but three times. They look at you with disgust and speak to you as if you don't understand French. Zero professionalism. If I could, I wouldn't even give it one star.

Our experience with this veterinary clinic is mixed. On the one hand, we had incredibly kind veterinary assistants, administrative staff, and doctors, but we also encountered situations that could have been very serious for our cat, in addition to the very high prices. We found her in the street with a paw injury, a wound that had formed because her paw was completely flat instead of being raised as it should be. So her back "elbow" was rubbing against the ground. We treated her wound following our vet's recommendations while waiting for an appointment with the orthopedist. We could feel an improvement; the wound was smaller, even though a black scab had formed. We had the consultation with the orthopedist, who examined her for exactly 30 seconds and told us, with a look of disgust, that her wound was gangrenous, that her paw would require extensive surgery and suffering, and that the best solution would be amputation. Luckily, our neighbor is a veterinarian! He examined her when I told him the diagnosis and said her paw was doing very well. He didn't think she was the type of cat who would need amputation and that he could take her with him for the day to consult with specialists and get an X-ray (which wasn't done at all at the veterinary hospital in the north...). In the end, her wound was healing very well, and the X-ray showed that her injury wasn't so serious and that we could wait until she finished growing to have a metal plate fitted. We waited, and simply good care and rest allowed her paw to heal on its own. She didn't even need surgery. Thank goodness we got a second opinion! Now she has all four legs and frolics happily! Lesson learned: for such major surgeries, always get a second opinion...

Excellent experience at this veterinary hospital.

The facility is clean, calm, and welcoming. My cat was very stressed upon arrival, but the veterinarian was very gentle and patient, which quickly put her at ease.

I also appreciated that she took the time to ask me questions, explain the situation clearly, and show me where my cat would stay during her examinations. This was very reassuring.

Professional, attentive, and compassionate service. I highly recommend them.
Courteous staff, they took great care with our family pet 🐶 …

I went there a few years ago because it was close to where I lived and my cat had an UTI. She was a chubby cat (17lbs) but definitly not crazy fat. So the first time I went there they did the urine analysis and they did a scan which amounted to about 1000$ But yeah whatever right? Then she got another one and they said its because she is fat and she cant clean herself...they wanted me to pay again the 1000$ to make sure it wasnt another type of uti.. It seemed to calm down a bit then I moved and went to another vet and they looked at her and asked me if she was diabetic because she walked a bit funky or that she may have a neurological issue. They did not go with the fat shaming route, they actually told me something was wrong then more issue went on and in the end she had the FLV (my new clinic also missed it because of the order the symptoms presented themselves with) but...they actually gave me other option and cheaper option when it came to care for my cat. I understand health and science is a tricky thing as living being do not follow specific rules..but they should have digged more than making me spend few 1000$ just for wanting the scans becauae she may have a different kind of uti and not went the fat shaming road...But hey! They were kind people....
Friendly and always there to answer to your pet's needs
A great team that listens
Always excellent service: fast, courteous, and very professional. I always manage to speak to someone quickly, even in emergencies. Highly recommended!
Great approach, I felt confident, and I was happy with my visit and the service from the whole team!
All the staff are very welcoming and professional!
Amazing! They took me and my cat in as an emergency when my own clinic refused... no space. The staff were kind, caring, and the atmosphere was warm. BRAVO! I'm a convert! ❤️❤️❤️

I hesitated before writing a review. I must say that they have very kind and empathetic administrative staff and technicians, and they usually have quick appointments. I went there for two euthanasias, unfortunately for my elderly cats, and they were very empathetic, even though the total price was twice as high as elsewhere.

But… my experience during my cat's last visit was awful. First, the vet was almost an hour and a half late with no explanation other than a casual "I'm running late." My cat is elderly and anxious; I have to give him a sedative before each appointment, but since I was early and appointments are often delayed, my cat refused to be handled after all that waiting. And their prices… what more can I say than that they are clearly exorbitant for everything! More than double what most clinics charge. I don't understand how clients agree to pay so much and feel obligated to accept it. The vet made me wait several days without returning my call to renew my cat's essential medication. I had to ask my pharmacist for help... Why offer a monthly and annual refill when it's an illness he'll have for the rest of his life? It's so I'll buy the medication at the clinic and not at the pharmacy.

Well, today my cat was seen elsewhere, and his medication will be the same, and his checkup is perfect, all for less than half the price with excellent care! I would be ashamed to be so ambitious with your clients, who are often vulnerable with their pets. It's so disappointing to rely on them for the best for our animals, only to realize that all they care about is taking as much money as possible from clients. I'm not that naive.

I wasn't a client of this clinic, but we were welcomed with great empathy and kindness by the entire team for the euthanasia of Cheese Wiz, who was over 19 years old, since my usual veterinary clinic doesn't offer this service on Saturdays. A special thank you to Marie-Claude for her support, which made this difficult experience much easier.

Dr. Cantin and her team are incredibly caring and professional. You can tell they love animals and want the best for them. Their service is efficient, reassuring, and compassionate. I highly recommend them!

We went for a post-adoption check-up with my cat, and the experience was excellent from start to finish 😊
The staff are simply amazing: attentive, caring, and incredibly gentle with the animals. You can tell they genuinely love what they do, and it makes all the difference. They took the time to answer all our questions and reassure us with clear and tailored advice.
It's very reassuring, especially after an adoption, to feel so well supported.
We'll definitely be taking my cat to them for follow-up care 🐾
Always good service :)

I'm happy with the North Veterinary Hospital; they are compassionate and understand the issues I'm facing when I talk about my cat, Mademoiselle Cléo. I'd also like to add that the receptionist, Flavie, is a wonderful woman, always with a beautiful smile and very helpful.

I went there in an emergency because I thought my cat had something stuck in his throat. The technicians (I'm not sure if that's their job title) Flavie and Valérie (I think) were incredibly kind. They were both very warm and welcoming. The veterinarian, Dr. Farraro, was too. It was my cat's first time at a vet, and I wasn't sure if the shock would make him nervous once we got home, but on the contrary, he seemed perfectly fine. For me, that's a sign that the whole team took excellent care of my furry baby, Tilou. 🐈‍⬛ I was in tears and in shock when I arrived. The entire team was wonderful to me. 🩷
The staff are really friendly and the place is clean ☺️ I came here for my little Bella

Prices are sometimes a little higher than elsewhere, but the staff is always attentive. They usually have an appointment within 24 hours for minor emergencies. It's helped me many times. I highly recommend it!

I only went there twice, once for a diagnosis and the second time for euthanasia. Despite the limited number of visits, I received incredibly empathetic and understanding treatment, and even a condolence card signed by the entire team! (Which touched me deeply.) I am truly amazed and wanted to thank all the team members for their kindness and attentiveness. 😊

The staff are very friendly and attentive to my dog. Everything is explained clearly, and I feel confident with the vets and assistants.
I highly recommend them!
A wonderful, warm team who are dedicated to our companions. Thank you for everything!
A wonderful, dedicated team ♥️🐾 …

The clinic was able to see us the same day we called to report a problem with our dog, who was feeling unwell. The reception staff were exceptionally welcoming and friendly. We were able to get the results of an X-ray and blood test during our appointment, after a relatively short wait. Our dog was therefore able to quickly receive the care she needed, and we are very grateful!
5 star service

An incredible team, warm and welcoming, and above all, attentive to our needs. If you need or are looking for a great place for your furry friends, I highly recommend the North Veterinary Hospital!

And to the team, thank you for taking such good care of my Luna!

Have a good day!
I recommend this hospital to everyone, the staff are very friendly and warm, especially Flavi, who always has a huge smile and is so loving!
Excellent service! Very courteous staff! 👍🏼 …

Simply exceptional service! From the moment I arrived, I was greeted with remarkable kindness and care.

The receptionist (Flavi) was just incredible; she truly took the time to listen, reassure me, and explain each step, which makes all the difference when it comes to our animals' health.

All the staff are exceptionally professional: competent, attentive, and always taking excellent care of my animals. As for the veterinarian (Dr. Ferraro), her extensive expertise and compassionate approach inspire complete confidence. You can feel her genuine passion for her work and her deep respect for animal welfare.

A veterinary hospital where quality care, respect, and empathy are at the heart of every interaction. I recommend it without hesitation, 100%!
Friendly and competent team, I recommend them.
Nice and welcoming staff 😃 …
A team that is both professional and empathetic! An independent establishment where you feel confident.

A caring team; I received a personalized card in the mail wishing me strength after the euthanasia of my old cat, Tiger. They were incredibly compassionate from beginning to end, and even beyond. A huge thank you to the team 🙏🏻 …

I ended up changing veterinary clinics after a few years for the following reasons:

- Exorbitant/uncompetitive prices
- The Apoquel treatment wasn't adjusted to my pet's weight (after review of the medical file by the dermatology specialist). The treatment was suboptimal, even ineffective, for some time.

- An appointment with a veterinarian is now mandatory for Cytopoint injections (with a 2-week waiting period) versus the possibility of walk-ins with a veterinary technician elsewhere.
- The veterinarian I was seeing for the first time told me he couldn't help me unless I could properly name all the treatments I'd tried, instead of opening and reviewing the medical file because, in short, I had said DUOXO Calm instead of DOUXO Calm. - A ten-minute lecture from a veterinary technician because I opted for a raw food diet.

- A few other bad experiences, including one where the dermatology specialist had to intervene an hour before closing time to ensure I received the two gabapentin (sedative) tablets she had prescribed for surgery under anesthesia the following day, as I had already called the clinic that morning to request them.

Response to the clinic's comment (December 11, 2025): My pet has been insured—fully comprehensive, including preventative care—since he was a kitten. He is now five years old and has had his annual checkup and heartworm screening every year. During these annual veterinary appointments, I also pick up the parasite control medication for the season. For medication refills, we were asked to allow 48 hours to give a veterinarian time to review the animal's file...

Review from a former client with a background in human pharmacology/toxicology

An exceptional team saved our beloved Pistache's life by providing him with heartfelt, tenacious, and highly professional emergency care, while supporting us through those trying hours with empathy and kindness. I wholeheartedly recommend them without hesitation. Thank you from the bottom of my heart!

Went from west island to this vet to follow the greatest vet Dr.Josee Ferraro...she has taken care of MANY of my dogs throughout the years..trust her completely. The only thing I would say about this vet is that it's not very "big" but at least they have parking avaliable to clients..and the staff is very welcoming
Extremely attentive and competent staff, they always take the greatest care of my little princess!
A very welcoming team, sensitive to animal welfare. I recommend them 100%.

Excellent veterinary hospital. I've been to many other clinics for my cat, who is frequently ill, and this is the first time I've encountered such gentle, empathetic, and kind staff. I highly recommend them!

My dog ​​always drags me to the North Veterinary Hospital during our walks. He always receives a very warm welcome from everyone, with lots of cuddles and treats. Having been with another veterinary clinic for years, it was only today that my dog ​​had his first appointment there with Dr. Cantin and Dr. Schnepf. Words fail me to express my gratitude. The examination was conducted with the utmost respect for my dog's limitations. His well-being was clearly a priority, and both veterinarians were very attentive to his signs of discomfort and pain. From the bottom of my heart: a huge thank you to the entire team, and see you soon!

Excellent clinic and excellent service! I arrived yesterday for a dog emergency and had an appointment first thing the next morning. I want to thank Dr. Camille and the veterinary assistant Flavi for their attentiveness and service!

What a reassuring experience!

A superb team: a warm welcome, smiling and attentive staff. The explanations were clear and easy to understand. My dog ​​got an appointment quickly for a minor emergency and was treated like royalty.
I highly recommend this veterinary clinic!

Their service is terrible; if you don't have an appointment, don't go there. They won't even check your dog. I arrived at 8 am when they opened, and they wouldn't even help me with my dog. It's not very hospital-like, very disappointing.

I have mixed feelings about my experience at the North Veterinary Hospital. On the one hand, I loved the service I received from Dr. Cantin. She was gentle and attentive with my kitten, and she also gave me a lot of information and explanations. I really appreciated her approach. However, on the other hand, I found their prices exorbitant… $940 (including tax) for neutering my male kitten and microchipping… I called other clinics to compare prices and found prices under $300 elsewhere. I was also quite disappointed with my last experience because they charged me for a consultation ($124 + tax… also very expensive compared to other clinics) for my kitten's second vaccination, even though they had told me a month earlier that a consultation wasn't necessary for the booster shots. I contacted other clinics and indeed, a consultation isn't mandatory before the booster dose. In short, very disappointed :(
Warm welcome, excellent 5-star service
Excellent and attentive service!
Flavi at the front desk is the best! Always veryyyy helpful and attentive.

Avoid this place at all costs! If you love your pet, go elsewhere! The veterinarian who saw my cat did a cursory examination and recommended tests and performed an unnecessary procedure. My cat suffered for a week due to a misdiagnosis. A week later, at the Laval Veterinary Center, incurable oral cancer, easily visible during a thorough examination, was detected and we had to euthanize our cat on the spot. My only consolation is that the team at the Laval Veterinary Center was extremely respectful and compassionate. Whereas at the Northern Veterinary Hospital, when they learned of the death of an animal they had misdiagnosed, they showed total indifference... They are surely used to receiving this type of testimony. Run and avoid the Northern Veterinary Hospital!!!
Good service

I typically don't post bad reviews, but I think it's really important to share my bad experience when it comes to the life of my cat.
It had been a few days that my cat was lethargic and had issues eating, which is highly unusual for my gluttonous cat. I will say, I appreciated that they agreed to see him the same day. The staff all seemed very kind. Those were the only positives.
We did x-rays and a blood test. This visit came to $1200. Steep, but if I could save my baby, it would be fine. When I got the results of his blood tests, the vet told me she highly suspects FIP. This is a death sentence if you don't act quick. The symptoms progress quickly and your cat could potentially only have a few weeks. Up until last year, the treatment was not available for compounding in Canada so had to be shipped from the UK and it was incredibly expensive.  I was barely informed of the expensive treatment option and was more or less told I might have to prepare to lose my cat if it was FIP.
The vet then suggested a PCR test to possibly diagnose FIP (FIP is also notorious for giving false negatives, so a negative wouldn't necessarily mean he didn't have FIP). The results would take over a week to get. Keep in mind that my cat had already been feeling unwell for a few weeks at this point and if it was FIP, it would be possible that he didn't have much longer.
After doing my own research, I learned about the pharmacies in Ontario (trutina pharmacy and Clearpoint pharmacy) that are licensed to compound the treatment now in Canada and got in touch with them as well as a a renowned vet in Ontario who was consulted in getting the medication available in Canada. The pharmacy and the vet both got back to me the same day and tried to work with me to get the vet at hôpital vétérinaire du Nord on board with the treatment (I couldn't get the treatment without a prescription). I sent them over the bloods and they informed me I have to start him on treatment ASAP because there is a strong possibility that it is FIP and that waiting to get a definitive diagnosis might mean my cat dying.

While I would understand the hesitation in prescribing medication they are not familiar with, especially given that they don't have a definitive diagnosis, I was absolutely heartbroken that the vet wouldn't even speak to the pharmacy or the vet in Ontario who offered their support. I would also understand not wanting to take my word for anything because I have no qualifications, however even when the pharmacy called the vet office, they refused to speak to the pharmacist. Instead, they suggested I run more tests and if my cat's situation deteriorates, to go to urgent care.

My cat is not even 2 years old and had no other health issues. If his symptoms were due to other ailments, he would have more time. The FIP treatment has no serious side effects (only mild). I fail to understand why I couldn't give the treatment for FIP and use that as a diagnostic tool (which is what other vet suggested). If he hadn't gotten better, I would have kept investigating with the peace of mind that his death wasn't a few days away at least.

In the end, the pharmacy in Ontario helped me find another vet near Montreal who was familiar with the treatment and had gotten the medication from them before (vétérinaire 640 in Saint Eustache). They agreed to see him right away, gave me the prescription while also ensuring that I fully understood the implications, and I was able to get my baby the treatment he needs.

The treatment works really fast. In just two days he was eating again. It's now been almost 3 weeks and he has his energy from when he was a kitten.

I spent about $2000 at this clinic only to be told they want me to spend more money and run more tests when my baby could have died in the process of waiting. At the other vet, I spent $350 in total for consult + partial ultrasound + prescription + appetite stimulant. $950 at the pharmacy for the treatment.
I'm not saying stay away from this vet, but do your due diligence. They are extremely expensive and didn't help

I highly recommend the North Veterinarian! The service is always warm, professional, and attentive. A huge thank you especially to Flavi, who stands out for her kindness, gentleness with animals, and attentiveness. You can tell the veterinarians truly love what they do, and it makes all the difference. My pet was treated with care and respect from beginning to end. The entire team is welcoming and reassuring. Truly a place you can trust!
Excellent customer service, they are kind and passionate about animals, it's clean and the background music makes it cozy, thanks to Flavi's good humor 🫶🏻 …
Good care and several vets on site
The North Veterinary Hospital in Ahuntsic is a comprehensive, modern, and welcoming facility where animal welfare is paramount. I wholeheartedly recommend it to dog and cat owners in Montreal!
Very insensitive and only want your money.

Honestly have been here multiple times with my cat, in the past month and a half she was rapidly getting worse. Took xrays, blood tests and gave treatment for 2 completely different diagnosis( which in total cost us about 3k)  for my cat to be officially diagnosed with Cancer by a DERMATOLOGY specialist that was able to diagnose in about 15min. She passed away a couple days after the diagnosis as she was in final stages.How can 2 different doctors not be able to see signs of cancer?  I would not recommend going here, the doctors dont do proper exams . As a patient you pay an already more expensive  price for a consult compared to other places And expect the doctor be competent enough to do their jobs properly. Please save your money and go somewhere else. Our cat was in an immense amount of pain and was put through unnecessary testing and treatment plans that didnt even help one bit with her level of pain and discomfort. My boyfriend advised me he also had a misdiagnosis with his cat at a previous appointment last year. So this is not a unique scenario. Btw a specific vet was following my cats journey and no follow up was done by them knowing we would be coming back after the testing with the dermatology specialist. Her records we’re sent to them after our appointment with the derm. THEY DO NOT CARE. PLEASE GO SOMEWHERE ELSE FOR THE SAKE AND HEALTH OF YOUR PETS. 🙏
After comparison, the bill rises faster here than in 2 other places.

Exceptional service! Honestly, I had some concerns after reading some reviews. But, well, human nature being what it is... My cat had seriously injured his paw, but I never felt pressured into anything before, during, or after his treatment. A fantastic team: from arrival to departure. A thousand thanks from me and my cat, Captain Turbo.

I recently lost Megane, my little cat who was with me for almost 20 years and whom I had brought to them for treatment. The staff were very attentive and caring, even calling me at home several times to check on her. …
Thank you we really appreciate it!

A gem. The staff is qualified, humane, empathetic, and caring. In my cat Sue's final days, Dr. Cote and the veterinary technicians answered my questions and were very patient because I was very emotional and couldn't retain all the …
Good service. Good pet food available on site.
They're good at fleecing you without any worthwhile results; I'd even call them charlatans. They didn't even notice she was blind. Bravo, $250 just to tell me (more tests would be needed).
The team is dedicated to animal welfare and provides quality care. However, the administrative staff is unreliable, and invoices should be checked. …

Thank you to the entire team for your exceptional care of my cat, who had surgery for a tumor under her whiskers in September 2024. Dr. Gervais, you have magic hands! Bravo for your meticulous and successful work. …

Prices are very very high.
The wait times are long. …
I wonder why the prices are so exorbitant…? $183.92 for a Cytopoint injection when I just paid $116 at another clinic. HOW CAN THE DIFFERENCE BE SO HUGE? How can such a price be justified? …
They are very competent and caring; I have great confidence in them to support my family as our beloved old cat ages.
Top team! Dr. Asselin is just amazing 🤩 My dogs adore him! ❤️ …
